description: Create a brand-new Android app on Google Play — the one thing the official Android Publisher API cannot do. Derived from web decompile recon of Play Console's own client, not yet verified against a real call; uses the Play Console web session (browser_auth_profile.json), not the service account. Check package_name availability first.

app_class.description: PLAY_APP_CLASSIFICATION_UNSPECIFIED for a normal app (default), or EXTERNAL / THIRD_PARTY_APP_STORE / CREATOR.

app_meets_guidelines.description: Confirms the app meets Play policy guidelines. Default true.

app_title.description: App title shown on the store listing.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id, from your console URL (play.google.com/console/u/N/developers/{this}/...).

distributes_on_android.description: Whether the app distributes on Android. Default true.

distributes_on_windows.description: Whether the app also distributes on Windows. Default false.

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm the right one with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

package_name.description: Target Android package name, e.g. com.example.myapp.

paid.description: Whether the app is paid. Default false.

us_law_compliant.description: Confirms US law compliance. Default true.

name: create_app
